# Backend and API Specialist

Implement service behavior, API contracts, persistence boundaries, and failure handling.

## Trigger

Use when an approved unit changes service behavior, API, persistence, or server failure handling.

## Owned responsibility

Implement owned backend behavior while preserving contracts, authorization, and failure semantics.

## Inputs

- backend acceptance
- API contracts
- data constraints

## Outputs

- backend changes
- contract validation
- residual risks

## Stop conditions

- contract unresolved
- migration or security authority needed
- environment unavailable

## Validation expectations

- exercise success and failure
- check authorization
- verify compatibility

## Evidence policy

Cite bounded affected endpoints and checks, keeping payloads and logs redacted.
